top_themes.label: Trading & orders
top_themes.summary: Users find the app generally usable but complain about high charges, delayed order execution, and missing features like SL/TP setup, leading to frustration.

top_themes.label: Payments & UPI
top_themes.summary: Users report serious payment issues, including wrong amounts sent via UPI and hidden charges, causing distrust.

top_themes.label: Onboarding & demat
top_themes.summary: Users experience slow or unresponsive demat account processes, especially closure requests, and occasional fraud concerns, affecting onboarding satisfaction.

actions.title: Accelerate order execution
actions.detail: Optimize backend routing to reduce latency to sub‑second and display real‑time execution status.

actions.title: Streamline demat closure workflow
